profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at Leidos
profile.summary: Results-driven and motivated Computer Engineer with demonstrated experience in designing, programming and debugging electrical products. Passionate about software development and C/C++ programming languages.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Programming in C/C++ for acquiring, recording and processing bathymetric and hydroacoustic data.
GUI design using Qt development tool for Windows and Linux.
Monitoring and managing internal and external code merges.
Performing product builds, handling and installing installation media and deliverables. 
Spending time on survey missions to analyze real time performance of systems and better understand needs of hydrographer customers.
Thorough testing of deliverable items for quality assurance.   
Troubleshoot and resolve code issues.

positions.title: Software/Firmware Engineer
positions.description:
Programmed embedded firmware and GUIs using C and Java for network switches and data acquisition devices.
Analyzed customer requirements to design electrical products, circuit boards and electrical schematics.
Designed front end software to assist with control systems automation using XAML and Visual Studios.
Troubleshooted and resolved electrical and code issues for returned merchandise.
Modeled products and programmed CNC machinery using SolidWorks.
Designed engineering processes to increase workflow and streamline tasks.

positions.title: Capstone Design Engineer
positions.description:
Worked with IGT and other team members to create a hands free lottery terminal device.
Implemented an audio detection library using Python so users could print and purchase lottery tickets using only voice commands.
Terminal responded to and assisted users according to designed use case and activity diagrams.

positions.title: Sales Associate
positions.description:
Proactively assisted customers across the sales floor.
Enthusiastically conversed with customers about purchases, needs and available products.
Prepared for promotions by rearranging stock and retagging merchandise.

volunteerExperiences.description:
Sorting, organizing and packaging donated foods, drinks and utensils
Carrying packaged goods onto trucks for distribution
Cleaning and maintaining the facility
